markdownRemark.html:
FabScene is cool. It brought today’s idea (as it turned out after I went to the page and translated the text, my idea matched a lot of what I understood from the picture alone).

In each new century, we need to use the appropriate technology. This time, meet Digital Ouija board powered by LLM

  • youtube video
  • translated page: https://fabscene-com.translate.goog/ne
  • github

Ouija boards use to be popular in the medium circles as a way of communicating with spirits (medium and spirits have double meaning in English, but I think you know what I mean here) and among teenagers when a company like Hasbro started to mass-produce it.

So this is a PCB board of a credit card size. It has many LEDs for every stop like on Ouija board, which are 26 letters and 10 digits (there also supposed to be Yes and No for short answers, but the digital version skipped them).

References

  • https://learn.adafruit.com/bluefruit-ouija-board/board-teardown - the magnet travels in a perfect arc, boring
  • https://github.com/ab3nd/ouija_board - brainstorm and overview of technologies: field visualization film, Hall effect
  • Probabilistic analysis about predictions from LLM, similar to monkeys trying to type in full Shakespeare novel
